user_data.lat: Latitude of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 46.2561. North is positive. Send it with lon, or null for both if you do not have them.
user_data.lon: Longitude of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84), e.g. 0.8047. East is positive; west of Greenwich is negative. Send it with lat, or null for both.
user_data._how_we_use_them: When present, the coordinates decide the commune the advert is placed in (the nearest commune within 25 km), ahead of commune_name. They are the way to place a property in a hamlet or lieu-dit that is not itself a commune. Keep sending commune_name and department_name as well.
